cohort: Individuals with a singleton, cephalic, live fetus who had one prior cesarean delivery and were undertaking a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) were included.
finding: Receipt of intrapartum oxytocin, at both lower and higher doses, was associated with higher odds of uterine rupture when compared with no oxytocin exposure, while a higher maximum oxytocin dose was also associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
mod_finding: Receipt of oxytocin was associated with both higher odds of uterine rupture and successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC).
